about_heading: Twenty years of smile design in Mid-Ulster
about_body:
Dr. Liam Diamond is the principal dentist and owner of Diamond Dental Cookstown, and has been designing smiles for 20 years.

That length of experience shows in how a case is planned. Every smile is discussed properly before anything begins, so patients know what is being changed, why, and what the finished result should look like.

services.name: Smile design
services.blurb: Planning the shape, colour and proportion of a whole smile before treatment starts.

services.name: Cosmetic dentistry
services.blurb: Cosmetic treatment matched to your face and the way you actually smile.

services.name: Smile consultations
services.blurb: A proper sit-down to talk through what you want changed and what it will involve.

services.name: Routine appointments
services.blurb: Regular check-ups and continuing care for patients of the practice.
